The '''Exocron Airfleet''' was the planet-based military force of the planet [[Exocron]].

==Organization==
The Exocron Airfleet operated several large [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] combat vessels, as well as several classes of [[skyfighter]]. Overall command of the fleet fell to the [[Supreme Admiral/Legends|Supreme Admiral]], and the fleet was based out of massive hangars on the outskirts of the capital, [[Caballa City]]. The flagship of the Airfleet as of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] was the [[sky-dreadnaught]] ''[[Maxion]]'' under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Horzao Darr]].<ref name="tmoe">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Masters of Exocron|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref>

Officers in the Airfleet were trained at a dedicated [[Airfleet Academy|academy]], and wore ornate uniforms with braiding and shoulderboards. Officers carried [[percussion pistol]]s and short swords as part of their uniform.<ref name="tmoe" />

The Airfleet maintained a security force which was armed with [[percussion rifle]]s with a bayonet blade, and they wore protective helmets.<ref name="tmoe" />

==History==
The Airfleet was formed to protect the government from aggressive factions that disagreed with the [[Devisors]]. During Exocron's internal conflicts, it supported Council forces, and afterwards concentrated on protecting from threats posed by the [[Corsairs]] from the western canyons.<ref name="tmoe" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Airfleet ships made first contact with off-worlders in the form of the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.<ref name="tmoe" />

By [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], it had been succeeded by the [[Exocron Combined Air-Space Fleet]], although Airfleet vessels were still an active part of Exocron's defense network.<ref name="votf">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
